correctness.rationale: From M(s)=exp(-ds)/cos(pi s/2), the bilateral Laplace transform of positive-index occupation is M/[s(1-M)]. Its only pole near the imaginary axis is the double origin pole with residues L/d+EX^2/(2d^2)-1, and an analytic contour shift yields exponential remainder. First passage has variance v/d^3, and the expected number of later below-threshold visits is bounded by M(s)/(1-M(s)). Direct finite inversion corroborates coefficients. Every step is justified in RESULT.md.
